name: Payroll jobs
definition: Jobs on employer payrolls located in New York City (all five boroughs), total nonfarm, annual average of monthly counts, in thousands, not seasonally adjusted.

latest_extra.note: Monthly count in thousands, not seasonally adjusted; compare with the same month a year earlier, not with the annual average. Preliminary.

source.name: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics (State and Metro Area), New York City, total nonfarm, not seasonally adjusted, series SMU36935610000000001

method: Annual value = mean of the 12 monthly not-seasonally-adjusted CES employment levels for the calendar year (thousands of jobs), rounded to one decimal. Monthly values come from the keyless BLS v1 API, which does not return annual averages.
caveats: Counts jobs, not people: someone with two jobs counts twice, and the jobs are those located in New York City, whoever holds them (commuters included). Self-employed workers are not counted.
CES estimates are revised each year when BLS benchmarks them to unemployment-insurance records; the latest months are preliminary.

Peers left out: CES publishes this city-level definition for New York City, but for most of the 25 peer cities it publishes only metropolitan-area or county figures, so there is no same-geography comparison.
